description: The Cognition Platform (known as Devin) and accompanying suite of AI tools provide capabilities to support the software development lifecycle for U.S. federal agencies and contractors. Devin is a model‑agnostic platform that uses machine learning models and AI techniques to perform deep codebase analysis and system interpretation, as well as automated code generation, testing, review, and deployment. Granular sandboxing and enterprise controls manage AI‑generated changes and allow organizations to balance performance and cost while maintaining security and compliance requirements. The platform supports engineering and security teams in protecting their codebases, modernizing legacy languages (including COBOL and Fortran), increasing developer throughput, and accelerating migrations and application modernization activities for mission‑critical federal systems.

description: DataRobot’s DataRobot for Government is a SaaS solution that uses artificial intelligence (AI) to help businesses and teams develop, deliver, and govern AI at scale. With DataRobot for Government, customers will be able to explore, build, train, and manage advanced machine learning and generative AI models. DataRobot for Government will display the best-performing models and provide insight on how they work, allowing businesses to improve efficiency in their AI workflows. DataRobot leverages Kubernetes, powered by Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), to set up the environment. Multiple Amazon EKS clusters and VPCs are used to provide single tenancy isolation.

description: Canopy is Ripcord's multi-tenant, Government-Only Software-as-a-Service offering for Federal Government Agencies that require Digitization-as-a-Service capabilities. It is a document intelligence platform that uses secure orchestration and workflow processing, robotics, OCR/ICR and image analysis, Google Gemini large language models, custom machine-learning models, business rules, and agent-in-the-loop quality assurance to digitize, classify, extract, validate, and deliver data from structured and unstructured documents. Canopy is deployed as a managed application tenant on stackArmor's The Armory General Support System.
